records.statement: Binance's approximately $5B of corresponding affected-token assets already held is an aggregate company-reported USD value. No XRP-specific amount, exact token quantities or token-by-token customer-liability match was disclosed.

The announced 12-hour special post-incident PoR target passed at 2026-10-31T07:33Z, but actual snapshot execution was not verified in the captured portal by 08:08:27Z. Results were stated due November 2. The regular November 1 snapshot is a separate cycle.
CoinDesk's October 1 PoR membership evidence concerns Binance 14 and ETH/USDT on Ethereum. It does not establish membership of the five Binance-labelled XRPL XRP source wallets.
Ripple's October 28 announcement says RLUSD collateral support for Coinbase Global Exchange customers will follow. Do not represent it as live collateral or current XRP market demand.

At the documented 10-drop minimum standard transaction cost, one million XRPL transactions destroy 10 XRP. This is protocol fee burn, not evidence of material XRP buy pressure without measured fees, reserves and actual market acquisition.

PR #1401 makes Cross Analysis artifact-only and removes direct main writes, but no longer updates tracked web JSON or triggers GitHub Pages. A separately reviewed Pages deployment is needed before merge if unattended public-site refresh must be preserved.

At 2026-10-31T08:08:27Z, 172 of 173 open PRs targeting main had base SHAs older than current main b90e600. Stale does not prove conflict; each proposal requires individual merge-base and changed-path validation. No bulk rebase or merge is safe.

No calibrated directional XRP forecast is supported. Provider market universes remain non-comparable; PR #1400 is a proposed forecast/outcome ledger, not a trained model; walk-forward evaluation, calibration, drift detection and shadow testing remain unexecuted.
